team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.desc: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.desc: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Forest's Curse
moves.desc: The user puts a forest curse on the target. This adds Grass type to the target's type. This also prevents the target from fleeing.
